# contentful_environment_alias (Resource)

Manages a Contentful Environment Alias, which routes requests from a stable alias ID to a selected environment. If you create the target in the same apply, use the [environment cloning example](environment#example-usage) to wait until the copy is ready before routing requests to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This example points staging at an existing environment that is already ready.
resource "contentful_environment_alias" "example" {
  space_id              = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_alias_id  = "staging"
  target_environment_id = "staging-yyyy-mm-dd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_alias_id` (String) ID of the environment alias. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space containing the environment alias. Changing this value replaces the resource.
- `target_environment_id` (String) ID of the environment reached through this alias. Changing the target redirects subsequent requests that use the alias.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite Terraform resource identifier in `space_id/environment_alias_id` form.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.
- `delete` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `read` (String) Includes retries and uses the duration saved in state (default `2m`, minimum provider timeout `10s`).
- `update` (String) Duration for the complete operation, including retries, for example `30s` or `5m`. Defaults to `2m`.

## Import

### By identity (Terraform 1.12 or later)

```terraform
import {
  identity = {
    space_id             = var.contentful_space_id
    environment_alias_id = "staging"
  }
  to = contentful_environment_alias.example
}
```

### By ID (Terraform 1.5 or later)

```terraform
import {
  id = "${var.contentful_space_id}/staging"
  to = contentful_environment_alias.example
}
```

### From the command line

```shell
terraform import contentful_environment_alias.example "$CONTENTFUL_SPACE_ID/staging"
```
